summary.name: FlowUs
summary.one_liner: FlowUs (息流) is a Chinese cloud-based knowledge management and collaboration platform combining online documents, knowledge bases, multi-view tables, and file storage.
use_cases: migrating notes from Markdown or CSV
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes FlowUs as a cloud notes-based platform offering online documents, knowledge bases, folders and multi-view tables for individuals and teams. Its documents can include text, tables, code, audio/video and embedded third-party services. The multi-dimensional table feature adds collaboration, information management and switchable views for lightweight business systems. Folders support uploading, downloading and previewing many file formats across computer and mobile. The page also mentions an embedded AI assistant, import of CSV and Markdown files, and 100+ solution templates.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Multi-view tables that switch between views for custom lightweight business systems
